user_direction: Head only, both icon and desktop sprite, no body; retain existing Jarvis style
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, precise-object-edit.
Redesign the JARVIS desktop companion as ONE compact floating ROBOT HEAD ONLY that works equally well as an application icon and an expressive desktop sprite.
Image 1 is the previous full-body character design: retain its recognizable silver/graphite/cyan industrial visual language, but replace the composition entirely with a purpose-designed head-only character. Image 2 is the original J-and-star shield brand reference: preserve its visual DNA, not the large letter as a substitute for a face.
Primary result: a single independent, self-contained robot head with a fully enclosed lower shell. Absolutely no neck, no shoulders, no torso, no limbs, no detached body pieces, no stand. This is not a decapitated/cropped robot bust. It is a complete engineered floating AI head icon.
Silhouette: compact almost-square shield-like head, broadly symmetric front view with very subtle 3D depth; strong chamfered silver perimeter, slightly recessed stepped crown, tapered lower jaw referencing the original shield. Disc-shaped temple mechanisms are small and integrated close to the silhouette, not bulky headphones. Keep a few broad layered armor plates with deliberate clean seams suitable for later opening/closing animation. Avoid clutter, greebles, bolts, cables, spikes and wings.
Face: a generous deep navy-black glass visor with TWO clear cyan luminous eyes, soft angular rectangular eye shapes, intelligent and calm with a subtle attentive expression, no angry brow, no mouth, no human features. Eyes are the visual focal point and must remain readable at 64 pixels. Use a small understated inset J mark on the forehead armor and a tiny four-point cyan star detail near one temple as brand echoes; do not fill the face with a giant letter, do not add text elsewhere.
Materials: original premium hard-surface 3D icon render, cool brushed silver titanium edge, charcoal and midnight-blue shells, sparse electric icy-cyan seams. Closely follow the supplied logo's material and color palette. Clean broad reflections and strong form hierarchy, high-tech mechanical intelligence rather than a toy or military combat helmet. No franchise resemblance.
Composition: single large centered head, straight and balanced, not tilted, square canvas with 12% clear padding all around, no collaged alternate versions, no labels or interface. Complete upper/lower contour fully visible.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA; subtle restrained cyan rim glow with transparency only immediately around head; no background rectangle, no floor, no shadow plane, no circular badge backing, no checkerboard drawn into pixels. The silhouette itself is the icon. Readable on both dark and pale desktop wallpapers.
Deliver a polished static head-only concept. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
